lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4Mg2 (reduced formula Ce2Mg) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 14 neighbors (8 Ce, 6 Mg) and Mg centers with 12 neighbors (4 Ce, 8 Mg), both exhibiting close-packed-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ce 14-vertex and Mg 12-vertex polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing among Ce polyhedra and edge- and face-sharing among Mg polyhedra.
